privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information we collect when you use this website, why we collect it, and what we do with it. We have tried to write it in plain language rather than legal boilerplate.

sections.heading: Information you give us
sections.body:
The only information we actively collect is what you type into our contact form: your name, and whichever of your phone number and email address you choose to provide, along with the service you select and the message you write. We ask for this so that we can answer your enquiry — nothing more.

If you call us or email us directly instead, we hold the contact details and job information you give us in the ordinary course of quoting for and carrying out work.

sections.heading: Information collected automatically
sections.body:
Like almost every website, our hosting provider keeps standard server logs which may record your IP address, browser type, the pages you visited and the time of your visit. These are used to keep the site running and secure.

We also use Google Analytics to understand how people find and use the site — for example, which services people look at most. Google Analytics sets cookies and collects usage data in an aggregated form. You can opt out using Google's browser add-on.

If Meta (Facebook) advertising tools are active on this site, a Meta Pixel may record that you visited, so that we can measure whether our advertising is working. You can control this through your Facebook ad preferences.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: A cookie is a small text file stored by your browser. This site uses a session cookie so that the contact form can protect itself against automated abuse, and analytics cookies as described above. You can block or delete cookies through your browser settings; the site will still work, though the contact form may not.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body:
- To respond to your enquiry and, if you ask us to, to quote for and carry out work
- To contact you about a job in progress or one we have completed
- To keep our own records of work carried out, as any business does
- To improve the website and understand which services people are looking for

sections.heading: We do not sell your information
sections.body: We do not rent it, trade it, or hand it to marketing companies. We will not add you to a mailing list because you contacted us about a broken pump.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
sections.body:
We share your information only where it is necessary to do the work or run the business:

- Our web hosting and email providers, who process messages on our behalf
- Suppliers or specialist subcontractors, where a job requires it and only to the extent needed
- Laboratories, where a water sample is sent for testing
- Anyone we are legally required to share it with

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: Enquiries that do not lead to work are kept for a reasonable period and then deleted. Records relating to work we have carried out are kept for as long as we may need them for warranty, tax or legal reasons.

sections.heading: Keeping your information safe
sections.body: The website is served over an encrypted connection, and access to the site's administration area is password protected. No system is perfectly secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect what you give us and we do not collect more than we need.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can ask us what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it if it is wrong, or ask us to delete it where we are not required to keep it. Contact us using the details below and we will deal with it.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: This website is intended for adults arranging work on a property. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

sections.heading: Other websites
sections.body: Where we link to another website, that site has its own privacy policy and we are not responsible for how it handles your information.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: If we change how the website handles your information, we will update this page and change the date at the top.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.notice: These terms cover use of the website. They are a sensible starting point drafted to match how the site works, but they are not legal advice and they are not a substitute for the written terms that should accompany the work itself. Have an attorney review them, especially the liability and warranty wording.
terms.intro: These terms apply to your use of this website. By using the site you accept them. If you do not accept them, please do not use the site.

sections.heading: What this website is for
sections.body: This site exists to describe the services we offer and to let you get in touch. It is a source of general information about well and water work. It is not a diagnosis of your particular water system, and it is not a quotation.

sections.heading: Information on the site
sections.body:
We take care to keep the information here accurate and current, but we do not guarantee that everything is complete or up to date at all times. Descriptions of services are general. What your property actually needs can only be established by someone looking at it.

Photographs of completed work are examples of jobs we have carried out. They are not a promise that your job will look the same or cost the same.

sections.heading: Enquiries are not contracts
sections.body:
Sending us a message through the contact form, or calling us, does not create a contract and does not oblige us to carry out work. Equally, it does not oblige you to instruct us. Work is agreed separately, in writing or verbally, before it begins — including scope, price and timing.

Any price mentioned on this site or given over the phone before we have seen the job is an estimate. Firm pricing follows an inspection.

sections.heading: Emergency call-outs
sections.body: We aim to answer emergency calls at any hour and to attend as quickly as we reasonably can. Response times depend on where you are, what else is happening, and conditions on the day. Nothing on this site guarantees a specific response time.

sections.heading: Using the site properly
sections.body:
You may read this site, print pages from it and contact us through it. You may not:

- Use the contact form to send unsolicited advertising, or anything unlawful, abusive or misleading
- Attempt to gain access to the administration area or any part of the site not intended for the public
- Copy the site's text, photographs or design for use elsewhere without our permission
- Interfere with the site's operation, or attempt to introduce anything harmful to it

sections.heading: Our content
sections.body: The text, photographs, logo and design of this site belong to us or are used with permission. Our name and logo may not be used without our written consent.

sections.heading: Links to other sites
sections.body: Where we link elsewhere, it is for convenience. We do not control those sites and we are not responsible for their content or their practices.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.body: We would like the site to be available at all times, but we cannot promise it. It may be unavailable for maintenance, or because of something outside our control. If you have an urgent problem, telephone us rather than relying on the website.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body:
The information on this site is provided as it stands. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for loss or damage arising from your reliance on general information published here, from the site being unavailable, or from an enquiry that does not reach us because of a technical fault.

Nothing here limits our liability for the work we actually carry out for you. That is governed by the terms agreed for that work and by the law that applies to it.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Maryland, United States, and any dispute arising from them falls to the courts of that state.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. The version published here is the one that applies, and the date at the top shows when it last changed.
